questions.question: Which of the following best describes closed-weight Large Language Models (LLMs)?
options: They are free to download and can be run locally for maximum privacy.
They are higher performing frontier models that typically involve variable costs or credit allowances.
They are exclusively open-source and require manual API configuration for cloud deployment.
They guarantee zero copyright infringement regardless of training data sources.

questions.question: What does a model's context length or context window primarily provide?
options: The total number of parameters used to train the model
The model's 'working memory' for accessing text while generating subsequent tokens
The maximum number of API requests allowed per month
The speed at which the model processes benchmark evaluations

questions.question: How does increasing context length typically affect a model's performance?
options: Model accuracy and performance degrade as context length increases
Model performance improves linearly with every additional token added
Context length has no measurable impact on model accuracy or speed
Models automatically expand their context window without any performance tradeoffs
